function: A video with subtitle tracks for two languages.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.function: Specifies the kind of text track

attributes.name: label

attributes.name: src
attributes.function: Required. Specifies the URL of the track file

attributes.name: srclang
attributes.function: Specifies the language of the track text data (required if kind="subtitles")
